note: Faithfulness, the story's shape and the stage are the metrics. A figure on screen, in the caption or in the alt text that does not reproduce from the fixture is a FAIL; a dropped hedge, an upgrade word or a cause the source does not state is a FAIL; a feature drawn on the stage that the source does not name is a WARN, a real brand or likeness the source does not name a FAIL. Never give a graded run this file, evals/README.md or any .KEY.md. Run one shape at a time, inline, no parallel agents. Every run that builds a page must run finalize.js and report its exit code; grade the page with check-video.js --final and VideoAudit.run({ exportProbe: true }) in Chrome or Edge over a local HTTP server, and look at the contact sheet.
